    • Method Detail

      • getBlock

        public Block getBlock()
        Gets the Block that is about to go up in flames

        Block Statuses: NOTE: Block statuses are subject to future removal. Use getCause() instead.

        • 1 - Lava
        • 2 - Flint&Steel
        • 3 - Spread
        • 4 - Burned Up
        • 5 - Lightning Strike
        • 6 - Small FireBall click
        • 7 - FireBall hitting a block
        Returns:
        the Block catching fire
        See Also:
        Block.getStatus(), IgnitionHook.IgnitionCause

      • getPlayer

        public Player getPlayer()
        The Player starting the fire if present
        Returns:
        the Player starting the fire or null if not started by a Player
